text:
You don't think about it.

That's the thing you'll remember later, in the versions of this night you replay when you can't sleep: you didn't decide. There was the student on the ground and the dark spreading from their hands and the knowledge of what it was, and then you were moving.

The counter-Weave is not in any textbook you've read. You're drawing it from the memory of what Lira's hands looked like, reversed — the Fracture pattern inverted, the frequency opposed. It's like trying to push two magnets together. Your arms are shaking.

The courtyard is very quiet. Everyone is watching you now.

choices.text: The dark retreats. The student gasps. The thread holds.
The thread doesn't hold. You tried — everyone saw you try — but the Fracture is older and deeper than anything you know how to oppose.
